newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical diversifies into new markets.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical diversifies into new markets.

text.p: United States Surgical Corp said on Wednesday it had more new products in its pipeline than ever before its corporate history and 1996 was a critical year as U.S. Surgical diversified beyond core market segments.

"Eight percent of sales during the fourth quarter came from products introduced within the prior year," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Leon Hirsch told a Piper Jaffray Inc analyst conference in New York.
He said 1996 was pivotal, because for the first time, U.S. Surgical made a large effort to diversify beyond its core sutures, surgical staples and laparoscopic products.

"Our main interest in this company is their state-of-the-art stent," Hirsch said. He said clinical trials for the new stent would start soon in the United States and the company expected European approval this year.
Progressive Angioplasty was also looking to expand its product line, he said.
In the area of urology, the company had a procedure to treat benign prostate hyperplasia, an enlarged prostate which constricts the urethra, under local anesthesia, he said.
The treatment involved using radio waves and a flexible scope to get rid of excess prostate tissue, the company said.
